scope: Per-item photo galleries, starting with Huntress and Harley; preserve the existing collection-wide gallery

dataModel.images: Ordered array per item: stable image id, src, thumbnailSrc, alt, caption, type (owner/reference), sourceUrl, credit, isPrimary
dataModel.fallback: Items without images continue to use images/thumbs/<id>.jpg

steps.work: Promote existing owner and downloaded reference photo metadata into item image arrays; use product photo as primary and retain owner front, detail and numbered base shots.
Add thumbnail strip and selected-photo area to item details, with caption, source link and visible Owner photo / Product reference label; show prototype disclaimer for references.

Add an image lightbox with Previous image / Next image, image count, keyboard arrows, Escape, focus trapping and focus restoration; keep collection navigation separately labeled Previous piece / Next piece.
Load primary photo promptly, lazy-load thumbnails, reserve aspect ratios and contain full statues; use locally hosted assets and graceful missing-image fallback.
Validate desktop and 390px mobile: every image selectable, keyboard navigation, no horizontal overflow, captions and credits readable, and all 47 legacy entries still work.

acceptanceChecks: Huntress shows 3 owner and 3 product reference images; Harley shows 2 owner and 1 product reference image.
The edition underside photo is accessible for both pieces.
Image navigation never changes the selected collection piece.
Reference photos are clearly labeled and attributed; original owner files remain unchanged.
Build and smoke checks pass; verify browser errors and broken-image handling.
publication: Implement gallery in a separate change; this file is a plan only.
